components.name: P19/Sidebar/Viewport
components.description:
Page 19 sidebar only. Full-page artboards retain their original content height. Sidebar rail represents a 1080px viewport: available rail = 1080 - 88 header = 992; sidebar = 992 - 18 top - 18 bottom = 956px. Resize the rail height to represent other viewport heights; sidebar fills it. Menu scroll viewport fills remaining space while footer stays at the bottom. Web equivalent: sidebar height calc(100dvh - 124px), menu min-height:0 and overflow-y:auto. Original 44px rows, 22px icons and 13px labels retained.

P19 Web source. Consumer: page 19 four full-page layouts. Original source 652:6042. Moved with original component IDs retained.
